decisions.reason: The existing same-message About-page update already describes email notification as available rather than unconditional. The detailed guidance for viewing or converting a prize is specifically requested for the new FAQs and does not necessarily alter the About-page process summary.
The Mission page describes reward mechanics at a high level and contains no winner-notification or email-guidance rule that becomes stale because of this source decision.

The candidate governs the mint number as a referral code and where that code is displayed. Conditional winner emails and prize-access guidance do not change referral-code identity or its display surfaces.
